name: Tripwise – Cheap Flights & Travel Deals
short: Cheap flights from your city, price alerts, hotels, car rental and tours. Free travel bot ✈️
description:
✈️ Cheap flights from your city in seconds
🔔 Price alerts when fares drop
🎡 Budget trip wheel: 3 cheap destinations for your budget
🏨 Hotels, 🚗 car rental, 🎟 tours and 📶 eSIM in one place

Just write where and when you want to go, in any language. Free.
